subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Financial Literacy Limits
description: Learn Financial Literacy Limits in one minute.

hook.text: Financial Literacy Limits: a simple choice shows how real behavior departs from strict rationality.

buildup.text: Financial Literacy Limits sets up the incentives, biases, and tradeoffs driving the choice.

discovery.text: Fernandes found financial education explains only 0.1% of variance in financial behavior.

twist.text: Just-in-time education works better: teach budgeting when taking a mortgage, not years before.

climax.text: Education matters but is insufficient alone. Combine it with nudges and structural changes for actual behavior change.

punchline.text: Knowing what to do and doing it are different problems.

quiz.question: Why is financial literacy education alone insufficient?
options: Financial content is too complex to teach
Knowledge explains very little of the variance in actual financial behavior
People forget everything within a day
